title: Existence of the finite strict completed Koszul tensor augmentation
statement:
theorem completedKoszulTensorQuotientAugmentation_exists
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal) :
    ∃ β : completedKoszulTensorTower T d r a ⟶
        (completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ),
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        completedAdicKoszulTensorUnit T d r a P n ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map (β.app P)).app (op n) =
            completedQuotientTensorUnit T d P n) ∧
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ) (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (hq : q ≠ 0),
        completedKoszulTensorSummand T d r a P n p q ≫
            ((HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map
              (β.app P)).app (op n)).f (p + q) = 0)

proof.text: Identify the completed Koszul degree-zero unit as an isomorphism by the constant rank-one identification, the zeroth exterior power equivalence, and the normalized scalar-extension unit isomorphism.

Construct the normalized degree-zero residue projection. Its composite with the incoming differential is zero because every a_i^(n+1) belongs to I^(n+1). Package it as a map to the single quotient complex. To compare successive augmentations, use the single-complex hom extensionality lemma and cancel the invertible degree-zero unit. The recorded Koszul unit transition and quotient unit transition then give the equality.

Apply the total tensor bifunctor to each coefficient augmentation and compose with the canonical total-tensor-with-single isomorphism. Naturality in both variables gives compatibility in the input complex and in the tower index. Assemble the transformation componentwise using NatTrans.ofOpSequence.

Compute on the degree-zero tensor summand using the total-tensor injection formula and the single-tensor collapse. Normalization becomes the specified ordinary quotient unit. In any nonzero exterior degree, the single quotient complex has zero object, so its component map and hence the tensor summand composite vanish.
